devdoc.details: Moving a token burns it on the source and mints the same token id on the destination (stock ONFT721). The message additionally carries the passport snapshot (revision, history hash, CID), so every chain can resolve the passport of the tokens it holds. Token and data are separate rights: the holder owns the token (transfer, send), only an issuer writes the passport (mint, revise), and the owner only configures (issuers, peers, base URI). LayerZero authenticates the sending contract, not the truth of the passport data: data validity still depends on the issuers, signatures and the physical-to-digital link.

Emits a {Transfer} event.
